{{Top|leg}}
The '''Droid carbonite emitter''' was an advanced model of the basic [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Droid carbonite projector|carbonite projector]]. This improvised weapon used a more efficient projector that was capable of freezing larger volumes more quickly.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
